decisions.reason: Grounded in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk 200 but sibling imports (src-*.js, pie-*.js, 97 siblings) resolve relative to the chunk URL and were never shipped, so dynamic import fails; proposes self-contained single-file bundle with splitting disabled (inlineDynamicImports/splitting:false) and notes the full-asset-dir alternative covers every dependency.

Correctly compares chunk-route.ts's startsWith guard with ci-note.md: LIB_DIR uppercase E: from import.meta.url vs realpath canonical lowercase e:; ordinal case-sensitive comparison rejects a contained file. Explains Linux and laptop pass by string-case coincidence, and explicitly rejects the 'Windows paths are unreliable' takeaway without claiming realpath always lowercases everywhere.

Proposes path.relative containment on canonical realpath-resolved paths with non-empty/non-'..'/non-absolute rejection, one-time case fold of both sides on win32 only, symlink escape re-checked after realpath, first guard fixed consistently, and JavaScript MIME type preserved for module import.

Explains pane ancestor handler and modal descendant handler both receive the same bubbling Ctrl+wheel; gives the modal exclusive ownership via stopPropagation plus preventDefault, with the pane handler also standing down for events targeted inside the modal.

Complete planned matrix with expected outcomes: shipped-artifact import-specifier assertion plus e2e with zero 4xx and SVG fallback; route unit test asserting 200 with JS MIME for case-differing contained path while traversal/absolute/symlink escapes stay 403; modal wheel test asserting zoom fires and pane font-size spy does not, with non-overreach complement.

caps.reason: Final advice strengthens containment (path.relative plus case fold, escape suite must keep failing); no affirmative recommendation to disable the guard or serve outside the lib root.
